item.title: Trump says U.S. warship's 9-month deployment "not nearly long enough"
item.description: The USS Abraham Lincoln has been deployed for almost nine months and is expected to be replaced in the Middle East.

item.title: Luigi Mangione's Guilty Plea, Explained | Case by Case | "48 Hours" Podcast
item.description: A major development in the Luigi Mangione case: after previously pleading not guilty to federal stalking charges, Mangione changed his plea to guilty and also admitted to shooting United Healthcare CEO Brian Thompson. CBS News legal analyst Caroline Polisi and CBS News legal reporter Katrina Kaufman examine what changed, why the plea change matters, and what comes next in the state murder case.

item.title: Five people killed in Northern Michigan, officials say; suspect found dead
item.description: Authorities are investigating the killings of five people Friday in rural Northern Michigan, officials said. The suspect in the case was also found dead.

item.title: Breaking down the logistics of USS Washington's replacement of USS Lincoln in Middle East
item.description: The USS Washington is on its way to replace the USS Lincoln in the United States' fight against Iran in the Middle East following reports of mental health issues and poor conditions on board. CBS News' Samantha Vinograd has more.

item.title: Blue Star Families official on toll have having loved ones deployed amid concerns about USS Lincoln
item.description: Maggie Meza, executive director of the Blue Star Families Southern California chapter, joins CBS News to discuss the toll of having a loved one deployed as concerns continue to rise about conditions on the USS Lincoln.

item.title: Video shows moment fighter jet crashed into mountain in Washington state
item.description: A new video shows the moment a fighter jet crashed into a mountain in Washington State in June. The pilot survived. Mark Strassmann has the details.

item.title: Air traffic controller saves day when 2 jets with same call number converge
item.description: An air traffic controller's quick thinking helped avert a dangerous situation when two jets, one landing in Phoenix and the other simultaneously taking off, shared the same flight number and radio frequency.

item.title: How AI is driving up consumer prices
item.description: CBS MoneyWatch reporter Megan Cerullo takes a look at the data on why artificial intelligence is raising costs.

item.title: American Airlines flies two jets with same flight number simultaneously in dangerous mistake
item.description: Two American Airlines jets were found to briefly share the same flight number and radio frequency in what could have turned into a major problem for the airline. Kris Van Cleave has more.

item.title: Around 16 million Americans face flood watches as waters rise in Midwest
item.description: Around 16 million Americans are now under flood watches as torrential rains devastate parts of the Midwest. Ian Lee has more.

item.title: Trump says USS Lincoln deployment "not nearly long enough" as concerns mount
item.description: President Trump on Friday pushed back against concerns about conditions aboard the USS Lincoln, a key ship in the Iran war. CBS News' Eleanor Watson has more.

item.title: Hawaii under a hurricane warning as Tropical Storm Lala takes aim
item.description: Tropical Storm Lala could bring heavy rain, high winds and dangerous surf and rip currents to the Hawaiian Islands as a hurricane this weekend, forecasters say.

item.title: 8/14: The Takeout with Major Garrett
item.description: Luigi Mangione pleads guilty to federal charges in UnitedHealthcare CEO murder; new aircraft carrier on way to replace USS Lincoln.

item.title: Why freshmen at one high school give their mothers a goodbye kiss on their first day
item.description: For the last 26 years at Bishop Kelley High School in Tulsa, Oklahoma, the seniors surround the cars of the incoming freshmen and don't let them out until they do one specific thing: give their mothers a goodbye kiss.

item.title: Here's the humiliating initiation ritual freshmen must go through at this Oklahoma high school
item.description: Steve Hartman goes on the road to uncover an embarrassing initiation ritual for freshmen at an Oklahoma high school.

item.title: "Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan" guests for Aug. 16, 2026
item.description: This week's guests include Gov. Andy Beshear of Kentucky, Rep. Don Bacon of Nebraska and state Rep. Christopher Rabb of Pennsylvania.

item.title: Thieves arrested in $10 million Italian art heist
item.description: Three masterworks lifted off the walls of an Italian museum last March have been recovered, and five accused thieves have been arrested. Jonathan Vigliotti reports.

item.title: Key moments from past week of Lindsay Clancy's trial for killings of her 3 children
item.description: The last week of Lindsay Clancy's trial for the killings of her three young children, which her defense argues took place in a state of postpartum psychosis, saw mental health professionals and autopsy doctors deliver powerful testimonies, with Clancy breaking down on multiple occasions. CBS News reports.

item.title: Midwest flooding grows as Indiana sees over a foot of rain with river reaching record level
item.description: Nine states from Nebraska to Virginia are under flood watches as heavy rains rock large swaths of the country. Ian Lee reports.

item.title: Ex-Cambridge professor dies week after resigning amid plagiarism allegations
item.description: Jason Arday, who was Cambridge's youngest Black professor, died in London on Friday, the school said.

item.title: Jason Arday, former Cambridge professor who faced plagiarism scandal, found dead
item.description: Jason Arday, the youngest Black professor at the University of Cambridge who resigned last week amid plagiarism allegations, was found dead on Friday. He was 41. BBC News' Helena Wilkinson reports.

item.title: Trump downplays concerns of mental health issues aboard USS Lincoln
item.description: President Trump is downplaying concerns raised by military families that conditions are poor aboard the USS Lincoln as the Iran war continues. Charlie D'Agata reports.

item.title: JD Vance says Republicans can't ignore economic concerns feeding rise of socialism in U.S.
item.description: JD Vance on Thursday told Fox News that the GOP can't dismiss economic concerns that he says are feeding a rise in socialism in the United States. Julia Manchester, White House correspondent for the Hill, and Juliegrace Brufke, Capitol Hill reporter and founder of the Sources Say newsletter, join CBS News to discuss.

item.title: FBI: Violent crime plummeted in 2025, murder rate hit 20-year low
item.description: The White House is touting a historic drop in violent crime as the FBI releases the latest data from its annual Uniform Crime Reporting Program.

item.title: 8/14: CBS Evening News
item.description: Latest on Luigi Mangione guilty plea; Trump denies USS Lincoln concerns.

item.title: Justice Department expands military's power to detain migrants near border
item.description: The Justice Department issued a legal opinion giving the U.S. military broader powers to detain migrants near certain areas along the southern border.

item.title: Golfer Jessica Bang, 18, dies while preparing for tournament in Thailand
item.description: Jessica Bang collapsed on Aug. 1 as she was preparing in Thailand for a tournament and was transported to a hospital in Bangkok.

item.title: Walmart tomato soup kits recalled over Listeria risk, FDA says
item.description: The 14oz soup kits were distributed at Walmart stores in 29 states between June 30 and July 7, according to the FDA.

item.title: Flock CEO responds to abuses of its surveillance technology
item.description: The CEO of Flock Safety apologized for alleged abuses of its service by law enforcement officers as the company rolled out new changes to how it operates.

item.title: Dad of USS Lincoln sailor worries about crew as deployment stretches on
item.description: The USS Abraham Lincoln has been at sea for nine months, and sailors have maintained a grueling pace amid the war in Iran.
